scope: Frozen synthetic stored predictions only; no retraining, retuning, or clinical rate claim.

policy.rule: Earliest eligible validation-threshold crossing, safety evaluated at that snapshot, at most one alert. No later snapshot may change an earlier decision.
policy.exposure: Sum of generated cycle lengths / 365.25 patient-years; not a clinical annual risk estimate.
policy.lead_time: Generated ovulation day minus alert day among true-positive cycles with present ovulation. Absent ovulation has no numerical event-day lead time.
